summary: GRAVEYARD batch pass covered all 12 Chief-selected active-batch companies (RKLB, CRDO, ALAB, NVDA, AMD, AVGO, TSM, ASML, ARM, MU, ANET, VRT) for fresh operating/regulatory/capacity signals and maintained universe-wide discovery discipline. Machine source probes are fresh, but FINRA remains partition-freshness only with eventDataAvailable=false and this pass did not independently clear every cadence-due active discovery family; discoveryScanCompleted must remain false. No batch company should advance from this lane alone.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: Q2 revenue reached $234M (+62% YoY) and backlog $2.36B; this is a material demand-validation signal across launch and space systems.
contradictions: Backlog growth does not prove margin quality or Neutron schedule success.
unknowns: Current FAA-license/cadence changes since the Q2 release were not fully re-swept in this pass.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: Repeated launch/certification delays or backlog conversion slippage would weaken the scaling thesis.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: FY2026 revenue accelerated to $1.335B with Q4 revenue $437M; PILOT and expanded AEC/retimer/optical portfolio increase optionality around AI interconnect bottlenecks.
contradictions: Top-10 customers were ~90% of FY2026 revenue, so weak-signal breadth is not equivalent to customer diversification.
unknowns: No independent patent/procurement signal was strong enough in this pass to change canonical state.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: Loss of a top hyperscaler or rapid optical/copper architecture displacement without Credo participation.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: Q2 revenue rose 104% YoY to $392.4M and Scorpio X-Series was expected to become the largest product family in Q3; Taiwan interop expansion is a concrete ecosystem/capacity signal.
contradictions: Product-family inflection is management-guided and still execution-dependent.
unknowns: Customer concentration and design-win conversion need full filing normalization before broadening the signal.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: Scorpio ramp misses guidance or major platform customers internalize/substitute the connectivity layer.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: Latest 10-Q confirms continued extreme AI demand but also a live geopolitical regime signal: H200 China licensing remains constrained and associated inventory/purchase-obligation charges persisted.
contradictions: Demand strength coexists with material export-control exclusion from China and customer concentration.
unknowns: No same-cycle BIS rule change was identified in this pass beyond already-filed company disclosure.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: Major sovereign restrictions, hyperscaler internal accelerators, or sustained gross-margin compression erode bottleneck control.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: Q2 2026 Data Center revenue reached $6.718B versus $3.240B prior year, while MI308/MI325 China restrictions remain a live regulatory constraint.
contradictions: Fast data-center growth does not establish accelerator share durability against NVIDIA/custom silicon.
unknowns: No new independent procurement or standards signal was sufficient for canonical promotion.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: Instinct adoption stalls or export restrictions materially shrink TAM while competitors improve software/ecosystem parity.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: Q3 AI semiconductor revenue reached $16.7B (+221% YoY) and the announced AI XPV platform targets >20GW of deployments, strengthening custom-accelerator/networking demand validation.
contradictions: Large financed infrastructure announcements can reflect demand pull-forward and counterparty concentration rather than broad independent demand.
unknowns: Ultimate customer concentration and project-level financing durability require deeper normalization.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: Hyperscaler custom-silicon programs diversify away from Broadcom or financed capacity fails to convert into deployed compute.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: Q2 2026 revenue grew 36% YoY; 2nm already represented 3% of wafer revenue and advanced nodes 77%, confirming continuing leading-edge demand/capacity migration.
contradictions: Geographic diversification remains incomplete because core leading-edge capacity is still heavily Taiwan-centered.
unknowns: Same-cycle permitting/water/power constraints for overseas fabs were not fully re-swept.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: Advanced-node yield/cost disadvantage, severe Taiwan disruption, or customer insourcing materially reduces foundry dependence.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: 2025 backlog ended at €38.8B with Q4 bookings €13.2B, including €7.4B EUV; management guided 2026 growth primarily from EUV and installed-base sales.
contradictions: China/export-control restrictions remain a structural policy sensitivity even when global backlog is strong.
unknowns: This pass did not obtain a newer 2026 quarterly primary release than the FY2025/Q4 baseline.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: Customer capex reset or export policy removes a material fraction of addressable demand while alternative lithography reduces EUV dependence.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: FY2026 revenue grew 23% to $4.92B with royalty revenue up 21%, supporting a continued mix shift toward higher-value architectures such as Armv9.
contradictions: Top-five customers were ~57% of revenue and Arm China alone ~16%, creating concentration/policy dependence.
unknowns: No independent evidence in this pass established how quickly data-center royalty economics can outgrow mobile concentration.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: RISC-V or customer-owned architectures materially weaken royalty capture or Arm China economics deteriorate.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: Micron reported record fiscal-Q3 results and HBM4 high-volume shipments for NVIDIA Vera Rubin; strategic customer agreements add durability signals across memory demand.
contradictions: Memory remains cyclical and the extraordinary margin/revenue step-up may contain scarcity economics that normalize as supply expands.
unknowns: Contract pricing floors and take-or-pay protections in strategic agreements are not public enough to quantify.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: HBM qualification/share losses or accelerated industry capacity expansion collapses scarcity rents.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: Q2 revenue reached $3.036B (+37.7% YoY); 1.6Tbps and liquid-cooled AI fabric platforms provide concrete evidence of product adaptation to AI scale-up/scale-out constraints.
contradictions: AI networking demand may be concentrated among a few cloud titans and subject to custom/internal architectures.
unknowns: This pass did not independently normalize current top-customer revenue shares from the 10-Q.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: Ethernet AI fabric share fails to expand or hyperscalers shift materially toward proprietary alternatives.

perCompanyCoverage.signal: Year-end 2025 backlog reached $15B (+109% YoY) with Q4 book-to-bill ~2.9x, a strong physical-infrastructure signal for power/cooling scarcity around AI data centers.
contradictions: Order surges can overstate durable end demand if hyperscaler build schedules slip or duplicate reservation behavior emerges.
unknowns: A newer Q2/Q3 2026 primary financial release was not independently obtained in this pass.
perCompanyCoverage.falsifier: Material cancellations/backlog aging or data-center power constraints delay customer deployments enough to impair conversion.

materialFindings.finding: Active batch is concentrated around AI compute/interconnect bottlenecks, making cross-company signals highly correlated rather than independent evidence of separate macro demand engines.
Outside-250 challenger XTND remains the only current discovery-pool item and still lacks normalized capital structure/runway; no admission proposal is warranted.
Automated required-source probes are 4/4 healthy, but FINRA only proves partition freshness and explicitly has eventDataAvailable=false; row-level OTC discovery cannot be claimed complete.

contradictions: Machine source-health is green while intelligent discovery completeness remains false; health/reachability must not be promoted into event-level completeness.
Several batch companies show record AI demand simultaneously, but common hyperscaler spending is a shared origin and must not be counted as twelve independent macro confirmations.
unknowns: All cadence-due active discovery families were not independently completed during this GRAVEYARD pass.
FINRA current corporate-action rows remain unavailable from the automated probe.
No outside-250 signal beyond XTND met the threshold for a sourced, entity-resolved challenger proposal in this pass.

peerRequests.request: Keep FINRA capability-vs-freshness explicit and verify exact machine-cycle CI for 20260914T0500Z.
Normalize customer concentration and contract quality for CRDO, ALAB, ARM, ANET, NVDA and AVGO before batch promotion.
Treat hyperscaler AI capex as a potentially shared upstream cause; test whether batch signals provide genuinely independent demand engines.
